gloss: as one wishes; as one pleases

definitions.gloss: as one wishes; as one pleases; freely; to one's heart's content
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something exactly the way one wants, without restriction or compromise. Conveys a sense of freedom and satisfaction.

examples.japanese: {思|おも}いのまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|い}きたい→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live as I please.
He can do anything he wants.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}いのまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I had been wanting a place where I could express my feelings freely.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{思|おも}い→思い：10248_omoi⟧ (thought, wish) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + まま (as is, unchanged). The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ often follows: {思|おも}いのまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧. This expression emphasizes doing something without constraint, following one's own desires or will.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {思|おも}いのまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to act as one pleases
- {思|おも}いのまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{操|あやつ}る→操る：12707_ayatsuru⟧: to control at will
- {思|おも}いのまま⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to go as one wishes

- ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: freely — more common and casual
- ⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧なよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: as one likes — casual, everyday expression
- ⟦{意|い}のまま→意のまま：22945_inomama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at one's will — slightly more literary synonym
